defect: With LLVM 21+, BPF atomic add/sub/and/or/xor return a wrong old value when the program uses the result; the stored value is correct and the verifier accepts the program. Seven live-result cases fail (32-bit add/sub/and/or/xor, 64-bit add/sub). PR 210371 corrects all of them.
